answer: Distinct-location dwell proofs make a new identity accumulate nonoverlapping, sensor-stamped presence at separate public sites, starting with a jetty gate. Each site issues a live challenge tied to local time, and a dune boardwalk camera logs the response, so one device cannot cover two identities at once. An attacker then pays the full dwell time plus travel and device wear per identity, while vine-tagged markers prevent replayed photos.
